receipt.public_excerpt: One issue that Deep Research struggle with is with the quality of the data sources it cites. The clearest example is this specific Reddit post, which ChatGPT cites six different times as a source in the section on monetization in the fediverse.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent audit of the same report finds problems with source quality. One Reddit post was cited six times in a single section.

receipt.public_excerpt: The quality of the article is mediocre however, and it lives in the twilight zone where it is impossible to tell for sure whether the article is generated by an LLM or written by a human.
